chapter: Ellington band: drinking, quarrels and rent parties
title: How Ben Webster got Bigard drinking and telling Duke off
summary: He did not drink until he saw Ben Webster curse Duke without answer, so he began on sherry with Johnny Hodges's wife and told Duke off all the time.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Did very many members of the band --

When I joined the band I didn't drink at all, and what started me drinking was Ben Webster. You see, like Duke sometimes would scold me for something, an insignificant thing. Ben Webster used to come in the band to get stoned and raise holy hell and cuss him out and everything else. Duke don't say nothing -- and get away with it.

So I said, "Why is he giving me hell for nothing? There's a man cussing him out and he doesn't say anything to him." So I said, "I'll try it," and that's when I started drinking. I started drinking with sherry wine and that was with Johnny's wife, Sue --
She and I, we used to go to church on Sundays drunk off of sherry wine.
And after you had the sherry, did you tell Duke off?
After you had the sherry, did you tell him --
Yeah, I tell him off. Yeah, I told him off all the time and he wouldn't say nothing to me.
I think sometimes he liked that.
